mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , t1.TR_YMD , t1.TR_CD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.JM_CD , t1.SEQ_NO , t1.AEKM , t1.TR_AEK , t1.TR_AEK - NVL(t1.MIJIGUB_TAX, 0) AS jungsan_aek , t1.MIJIGUB_TAX , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.MK_SUIK_RT , t1.SUSU_GA , t1.TAX_OFFER_GB , t1.JAJUN_GB , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , hm.BFIL_AEKM AS bfil_aekm , hm.BFIL_SIGA_AEK AS bfil_siga_aek , hj.KSD_JM_CD AS ksd_jm_cd , hj.HJ_NM AS xx_jm_cd , t1.MM_SONIK AS mm_sonik , CASE WHEN t1.AEKM > 0 THEN t1.TR_AEK / t1.AEKM * 10000 ELSE 0 END AS danga , 1 AS p_visible FROM SHT0HG t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD JOIN SHM0HM hm ON hm.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND hm.YMD = t1.TR_YMD AND hm.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND hm.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD JOIN SHM0HJ hj ON hj.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND hj.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND t1.FUND_CD LIKE #{fundCd} ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD, t1.JM_CD

SELECT hm.CORP_GR , #{trYmd} AS tr_ymd , #{trCd} AS tr_cd , hm.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , hm.JM_CD , hj.HJ_NM AS xx_jm_cd , hj.KSD_JM_CD AS ksd_jm_cd , ia.MG_CD AS tr_co_cd , hm.BFIL_AEKM AS bfil_aekm , hm.BFIL_SIGA_AEK AS bfil_siga_aek , hm.BFIL_AEKM AS aekm , hm.BFIL_SIGA_AEK AS tr_aek , 0 AS mijigub_tax , CASE WHEN hm.BFIL_AEKM > 0 THEN hm.BFIL_SIGA_AEK / hm.BFIL_AEKM * 10000 ELSE 0 END AS danga , 1 AS p_visible FROM SHM0HM hm JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = hm.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = hm.FUND_CD JOIN SHM0HJ hj ON hj.CORP_GR = hm.CORP_GR AND hj.JM_CD = hm.JM_CD WHERE hm.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND hm.YMD = #{trYmd} AND hm.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND NVL(hm.BFIL_AEKM, 0) > 0 ORDER BY hm.JM_CD
